sources.title: Brazilian Federal Police: Normative Instruction 173/2020 on travel documents
sources.officialityEvidence: The Federal Police's current official normative instruction distinguishes the common passport from other travel documents and limits its general eligibility to Brazilian-born or naturalized nationals.
sources.supportingExcerpt: São condições gerais para obtenção do passaporte comum: I - ser brasileiro nato ou naturalizado.

sources.title: Brazilian Federal Government: obtain a common passport
sources.publisher: Federal Government of Brazil / Polícia Federal
sources.officialityEvidence: The current federal passport service describes a passport as a travel document accepted to identify a traveller in another country and separately identifies diplomatic, official/service, emergency, foreigner and laissez-passer documents.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Passaporte é um documento de viagem ... aceito como identificação do viajante em outro país.

sources.title: Nigeria Immigration Service: 2026 Tourism (F5A) visa service level
sources.officialityEvidence: Nigeria Immigration Service's April 2026 service-level document establishes electronic F5A tourism issuance and its Appendix I assigns Brazil a payable single-entry fee, distinguishing it from the waiver cohort.
sources.supportingExcerpt: F5A Eligibility: Citizens of all countries ... Receive Visa certificate via email. Brazil $20 $20* $20 $20.

sources.title: Equatorial Guinea Government: online visa is operational
sources.publisher: Government of the Republic of Equatorial Guinea Information and Press Office
sources.officialityEvidence: The institutional Government page identifies equatorialguinea-evisa.com as the operational visa site and says interested visitors can obtain a visa online without attending in person.
sources.supportingExcerpt: todos los interesados en viajar al país podrán conseguir su visado sin tener que desplazarse físicamente.

sources.title: Equatorial Guinea eVisa: live eligibility, regular-passport and delivery translation asset
sources.officialityEvidence: The Government-authenticated exact domain's live English translation asset says all nationalities can apply, limits the process to a regular passport, and sends eVisas by email with PDF download.
sources.supportingExcerpt: All Nationalities can apply for an E- Visa ... All E-Visa are sent by email.

policies.title: Brazilian common passports: Nigeria tourism eVisa
policies.summary: Nigeria Immigration Service's current F5A tourism service routes eligible Brazilian common-passport applicants through electronic issuance and lists Brazil's payable single-entry fee.
conditions: Use the Brazilian common passport issued to a Brazilian-born or naturalized national, not a diplomatic, official/service, emergency, foreigner or laissez-passer document. F5A is tourism only, single entry and up to 30 days.
Apply online, upload documents and pay. The emailed certificate is electronic issuance before travel, not online preapproval followed by border issuance.

Although F5A excepts ECOWAS States and countries with visa-waiver agreements, Appendix I expressly assigns Brazil a payable $20 single-entry fee, establishing that this ordinary-passport route is not waived.

application.label: Nigeria Immigration Service eVisa portal
steps: Apply online with the Brazilian common passport and stated tourism documents.
Pay the applicable fee and obtain the visa certificate by email before departure.
Present the issued record for carrier and final-admission checks.

policies.title: Brazilian common passports: Equatorial Guinea electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Equatorial Guinea's Government-authenticated live eVisa service accepts all nationalities using a regular passport and sends the eVisa by email/PDF.
conditions: Use the Brazilian common passport used for travel; the live service excludes non-regular travel documents.
Register, upload visitor documents, pay online and obtain the eVisa by email/PDF before travel. This is electronic issuance, not a visa on arrival.
Purpose, passport validity, health, entry-point, carrier and final-admission requirements remain separate.

application.label: Equatorial Guinea official eVisa service
steps: Register using the Brazilian common passport for travel.
Pay and receive the issued eVisa by email/PDF before travel.
Carry the issued record for final immigration processing.
